name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 2 – Am 23
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 2a. Recalls that fundamental rights are best protected at national level, where they are grounded in the specific legal frameworks of each Member State; rejects the increasing tendency of the EU to use fundamental rights as a tool for legal activism to interfere in areas of exclusive national competence, such as healthcare, education, and the organisation of the judiciary; reiterates that the principle of subsidiarity is not a suggestion but a treaty-based obligation;
